notes: STAND-IN fixture (scripts/make_fixtures.py) so the demo can switch scenarios. Shaimaa's simulator replaces it. All values are simulated. S5 reuses the S1 history for Fahim; link delay setting: 24 min one way.

expected_outcomes: The consult summary starts as saved locally while the link is down
With the link up it moves queued -> sent -> delivered, each state shown with its time; one-way delay 24 min
'Reviewed' appears only after the medical team marks it reviewed
Sending again never creates a duplicate; the app keeps working while the summary waits
